title: Carve 0.2 caption number mark
description: The number mark of a caption. The block chapter carries the rule over from 0.1 (C2-B-150); the values here restate the 0.1 clause CARVE-P2-022.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

bare_when_followed_by.description: The mark is bare when one of these follows it.

not_a_mark.description: A `#` in these places is not the number mark. Sorted by name.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.
